_comment: docs/IP_VISUAL_IDENTITY.md 의 Flagship Cast 표를 기계 판독으로 투영한 것이다.
산문 정본은 그 문서가 계속 소유하며, 두 곳이 어긋나면 산문이 이긴다.
여기에 표에 없는 값을 채워 넣지 않는다. 빈 칸은 빈 칸으로 둔다.
검사용 키워드 같은 파생 값은 이 파일이 아니라 tools/identity_signature_audit.py 가 갖는다.

minjun.desire: Wants a different life without knowing what may remain of him
minjun.locked_silhouette: Lean shoulders, uneven black fringe, worn black crewneck in private life
minjun.owned_prop: Folded account statement showing the starting balance, never a luxury prop at launch
minjun.audio_motif: Four-note theme that can clear, distort, or hollow out

jiyeon.desire: Offers the fastest path upward while refusing to be merely a guide
jiyeon.locked_silhouette: Long one-sided black waves, sharp eyes, ivory tailoring over black
jiyeon.signature_material: Ivory lacquer / black automotive glass / fine gold geometry
jiyeon.owned_prop: Unbranded black luxury-car key and angular earring
jiyeon.audio_motif: Cool piano interval with a held unresolved note

daeun.desire: Has little to spare but notices what other people need
daeun.locked_silhouette: Short layered bob, fixed side hair clip, navy work line under beige knit
daeun.signature_material: Warm paper / convenience-store fluorescent light / faded blue stripe
daeun.owned_prop: Handwritten post-it and the same hair clip in every outfit
daeun.audio_motif: Close felt piano and soft room tone, never cute chimes

jaehyuk.desire: His kindness may be sincere and useful at the same time
jaehyuk.locked_silhouette: Swept hair, open black collar, smile that survives bad news
jaehyuk.signature_material: Camera flash / black mirror / wet bar table
jaehyuk.owned_prop: Pocha photograph with a darkened second reading
jaehyuk.audio_motif: Dry finger snap or shutter transient over Minjun's motif

sangchul.desire: The hand offering a ladder may be the hand that built the trap
sangchul.locked_silhouette: Salt-and-pepper sweep, patterned shirt, dark jacket, practiced half-smile
sangchul.signature_material: Worn leather / business-card stock / smoke-dark private room
sangchul.audio_motif: Low brushed rhythm and one muted brass breath

father.desire: Shame makes him withdraw from the son he is trying to protect
father.locked_silhouette: Narrow older frame, faded blue work jacket, plaid collar
father.signature_material: Faded workwear / old paper / weak phone light
father.audio_motif: Bare room tone with the four-note theme missing its last note
